drums.tags: Indie rock with post-punk influences. Clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, palm-muted eighth-note riff on the root note before opening into arpeggiated chords. A second electric guitar enters with a melodic lead line using light overdrive and chorus. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a driving eighth-note pattern. Drums feature a steady backbeat with prominent hi-hat accents and occasional crash cymbal hits. The arrangement builds through the addition of layered guitar textures. Key of E Major. 125 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[palm-muted electric guitar eighth-notes]
[bass guitar enters with steady root notes]

[Section A]
[clean electric guitar arpeggios]
[drums enter with steady backbeat and closed hi-hats]

[Section B]
[lead electric guitar enters with melodic riff]
[chorus effect on lead guitar]
[increased velocity on hi-hats]

[Section C]
[rhythm guitar switches to open strumming]
[crash cymbal accents]
[bass guitar becomes more melodic]

[Outro]
[lead guitar fades out]
[drums drop to kick and snare only]
[final sustained guitar chord with reverb]

bass.tags: Ambient electronic soundscape. A deep, resonant sub-bass synth provides a steady low-frequency drone. High-frequency granular synthesis textures and shimmering digital pads create a sense of vast space. A rhythmic, percussive element resembling a metallic click or a ticking clock repeats at 120 BPM. Sparse, reverberant piano notes punctuate the texture with long decay times. The piece is in the key of C minor. Subtle white noise sweeps and filtered synth swells rise and fall throughout the arrangement. The mix is characterized by extreme stereo width and heavy use of convolution reverb.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[low-frequency sub-bass drone enters]
[granular synth textures with high-frequency shimmer]

[Section A]
[metallic percussive click repeats at 120 BPM]
[reverberant piano notes with long decay]
[filtered synth pad swells]

[Section B]
[white noise sweeps]
[sub-bass drone intensifies]
[piano melody becomes more sparse]

[Outro]
[percussive click fades out]
[granular textures dissolve into silence]
[sub-bass drone lingers and fades]
